name: IBY_TEMP_INTERMEDIARY_ACCTS
description: IBY_TEMP_INTERMEDIARY_ACCTS is an interface table for intermediary bank account information.

columns.name: TEMP_INTERMEDIARY_ACCT_ID
columns.description: Primary key of this table. For Fusion, the value should come from Fusion common sequence - S_ROW_ID_SEQ

columns.name: TEMP_EXT_BANK_ACCT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IBY_TEMP_EXT_BANK_ACCTS.TEMP_EXT_BANK_ACCT_ID. The associated external bank account interface record

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the interface record.  Values are NEW, PROCESSED and REJECTED

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code

columns.name: BANK_NAME
columns.description: Bank name

columns.name: CITY
columns.description: City

columns.name: BANK_CODE
columns.description: Bank code

columns.name: BRANCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Branch Number

columns.name: BIC
columns.description: Bank Identification Code (Swift Code)

columns.name: ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Bank account number

columns.name: CHECK_DIGITS
columns.description: Check digits

columns.name: IBAN
columns.description: International Bank Account Number

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Enterprise identifier to support multi-tenancy.

columns.name: ENCRYPTED_FLAG
columns.description: Whether the instrument is encrypted.

columns.name: IBAN_SEC_SEGMENT_ID
columns.description: Security identifier of IBAN(International Bank Account Number).

columns.name: IBAN_HASH1
columns.description: Hash value of IBAN(International Bank Account Number).

columns.name: IBAN_HASH2
columns.description: Salted hash value of IBAN(International Bank Account Number).

columns.name: MASKED_IBAN
columns.description: Masked IBAN value to be used for display purposes.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM_HASH1
columns.description: Hash of the bank account number.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM_HASH2
columns.description: Hash of the salted bank account number.

columns.name: MASKED_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM
columns.description: Masked bank account number to be used for display purposes.

columns.name: BA_MASK_SETTING
columns.description: Current bank account masking setting values taken from lookup IBY_INSTRUMENT_MASK_SETTING.

columns.name: BA_UNMASK_LENGTH
columns.description: Number of digits to expose in the external bank account mask.

columns.name: BA_NUM_SEC_SEGMENT_ID
columns.description: Bank account number security identifier.

columns.name: BA_NUM_ELEC_SEC_SEGMENT_ID
columns.description: Electronically-formatted bank number security segment identifier.

columns.name: SALT_VERSION
columns.description: Denotes the versions of the encryption algorithm used for the bank account number encryption.

columns.name: INTERMEDIARY_ACCT_ID
columns.description: Intermediary bank account identifier
